tools.name: node_types
tools.description: Discover versioned node kinds, typed ports, defaults, JSON configuration schemas and capability status. Draft model settings do not authorize a run.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List durable workflows with current revisions and editor URLs.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Retrieve/reopen the complete persisted graph and its visual editor URL.

tools.name: validate_workflow
tools.description: Validate identities, typed ports, dependencies, cycles, configurations and groups without saving or executing. Incomplete drafts have readiness issues.

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Retrieve latest persisted run, node states and originating asset associations. Authoring does not call a model.

tools.name: get_assets
tools.description: Retrieve durable asset associations and their originating nodes, run IDs and declared provenance.

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create and save an empty workflow with a new ID. Existing IDs fail; never overwrites.

tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Atomically apply and save an ordered graph-change batch with one revision increment. Any validation error or conflict rolls back all graph and asset changes. Supports add/configure/remove/connect/disconnect, rename and groups.

tools.name: save_workflow
tools.description: Save a complete graph with explicit expectedRevision. Retrieve before replacing a graph. Cannot overwrite a newer revision.

tools.name: add_node
tools.description: Add and persist one stable node ID using a discovered kind/version. Defaults fill missing configuration.

tools.name: configure_node
tools.description: Merge configuration, optionally rename/reposition, then save at expectedRevision. Use apply_changes for atomic multi-node edits.

tools.name: remove_node
tools.description: Remove a node, its edges, group membership and asset associations transactionally. Existing run snapshots remain historical.

tools.name: connect_nodes
tools.description: Persist one typed edge. Reject incompatible ports, duplicate input connections and cycles.

tools.name: disconnect_nodes
tools.description: Remove an existing connection by stable edge ID and save at expectedRevision.

tools.name: associate_asset
tools.description: Associate a real imported or externally reported asset with an originating node and optional run. Preserves declared provenance; never marks a model run completed or spends credits.

tools.name: execute_local
tools.description: Execute and persist a wholly deterministic local workflow at an exact revision. Refuses graphs containing any generative node. No Weave generation request or model call is made.
